text: That's correct - if you don't provide proof of registration now, you will have to provide a personal status certificate at the end of the process. I am guessing you provided a consular or notary affidavit about your status when you began the process? You will have to provide the same thing, but just saying that you are married. You won't be able to provide it at this stage, as they will want it to be current when you are applying for citizenship
